decisions.reason: Report distinguishes the clipboard-text projection (draft/Occurrence, chip expanded to clipboardText) from the detect-text projection used by insertReference/consumeToken (chip = one U+FFFC, ordinary text at normal width), grounding both sides in host-input-contract.ts and host-input-facade.ts.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add() and connects the capture to the detect-span splice: with an empty composer both coordinates coincide (first paste ok), afterwards the clipboard length overshoots the 2-char detect text so insertReference returns false and the plugin throws its changed-composer toast; explicitly notes the fresh draftRev rules out a stale-revision or concurrent-edit cause.

Traces remove(): occurrence.offset/length passed unconverted to consumeToken, its return value not inspected, records.delete runs unconditionally, so the occurrence survives while the missing record renders 'unavailable' in the dock; ties both symptoms to the same clipboard-vs-detect mismatch rather than a separate upload failure.

Derives detectDelta = length-1 from the host excerpts and applies it at both call sites: insert uses draft length minus the sum of preceding deltas, removal maps occurrence.offset and uses a one-detect-character span; keeps the draftRev guard and retires records only after successful consumption. The mapping/pseudocode form satisfies the requirement.

Proposes two successive pastes asserting both occurrences/chips, then removal of a chip with a preceding chip while asserting the other chip survives and records/dock/composer stay consistent; adds empty-again, first/last-chip-style and trailing-space normalization variants. Item 5 checklist is present but correctly treated as unscored guidance.
